exit_rules: Every position gets a reduce-only stop-market order resting ON Hyperliquid (hard stop 2.5×daily ATR). After +1.5 ATR the stop moves to breakeven (+0.1 ATR), then trails 4 ATR behind the best price. If a position was ≥1.5 ATR under water and recovers to ≥1.5 ATR profit, half is taken off (maker). After a stop exit, no same-side re-entry until the traders' consensus goes flat/flips (max 72h). Account: −5% on the day or −15% from peak flattens everything and halts.
